_note: What the player's own voice says when they click a thing in the room (author playtest 2026-11-05: the room needs more to touch). One line at random each click, as an inner line. Claude's; en twin has the same keys and the same number of lines.

coat: One coat a year. After a year, another one.
Last year's company coat, logo on the back. No coat this year.
Still a staff badge in the pocket. The gate stopped reading it long ago.
Hanging by the door like I'm about to go out. I'm not.
It goes out more than I do. Last time it fell on the floor by itself.
bag: AI can do everything, and it still hasn't invented teleporting food.
A takeaway bag. Bags outlive the meals.
I throw them out in sevens. I've stopped counting where I'm at.
The bag says 'Every meal made with care.' I ate it with care.
door: Outside is the corridor, and outside that, the world. Not needed today.
Only takeaway and parcels come through this door.
Over ten days without going out this door. It hasn't missed me either.
With the door shut, the room is mine.
A rented flat: the door is the landlord's, the lock is mine.
lock: One lock, one chain. I put the chain on myself.
I don't check it because someone might come in. It's a habit.
The bolt clicks. That sound helps.
